about: Core files allowed to name incompressible physics (gate:h9-no-core-physics). Each entry says why; tools/core_physics_scan.py fails on an entry with no hit. if_vocab and if_vocab_sdk are the ratcheted Incompressible Flow vocabulary: the scan fails when a file's count rises above max_hits and when it falls below it (lower max_hits in the same commit).

files.reason: Frozen v12 migration of old project.json files: which initial-condition fields the seed gave each stored solver.turbulence value. Read only when a pre-v12 file is loaded; no run reads it. Only those table lines are allowed.
OpenFOAM install probe (Gate A0 smoke: simpleFoam -help). It checks that the WSL OpenFOAM has its solvers, not physics.
OpenFOAM install probe (simpleFoam -help), the same check as python/cfddesk/wsl/openfoam.py.
LEGACY_PROCESS_NAMES: the process names of runs started before launch specs (v0.2.0 and earlier), so Stop and Force stop still find them.
The product's required bundled plugin, by key and display name, so the app can say which plugin is missing when it cannot load it. Only that line is allowed.

if_vocab.reason: W18_LEGACY_AIR: the frozen Air record an older project's Air without numbers still reads (its name is also the default fluid's name when no material model is registered), and the kinematic_viscosity record key.
_LEGACY_MENU: the menu keys v8 project.json files hold for the seven BC type keys projects have always stored, so old projects load without the plugin.
Frozen migrations of pre-v12 project.json files (v4 BC settings, the v12 initial-condition inlet key, the old default BC names). Read only when an old file is loaded.
The fluid tree folder's DOM / stored-state key ('Air', fluidTreeKey: projects' stored tree state and LeftTree's Air:<study> key use it) and a saved material's kinematic_viscosity record key.
Material mirror rows keep the 1.x record key kinematic_viscosity next to nu for older readers of materials.json.
W19_VELOCITY_INLET_1 / W19_PRESSURE_OUTLET_2: exported example BC records with no reader left.
The unit system's kinematic_viscosity quantity (plugin-ui API: units, add-only).
_LEGACY_SEMANTICS: what kind of patch each of the seven stored BC type keys is when the plugin that owns them is not loaded.
The dev UI kit's resolveUnit example (dev page only, not shipped in the workbench).

LEGACY_MAGNITUDE_FIELD: the shown field records saved before result fields came from the analysis mean by the velocity magnitude (the 'Velocity Magnitude' Coloring label, an empty or magU/U stored field, and the field alias they still write). New tools take their default from the case's result fields.
The deprecated values['magU'] / values['p'] mirrors of the inspect RPC for older callers.
Inlet tagging falls back on the patch name velocity_inlet when a BC has no semantic class.
1.x re-export of the SDK's is_velocity_inlet BC-record helper.
Imported cases with no results.frameFields fall back on the U/p pair when 0/U and 0/p exist (could name LEGACY_FRAME_FIELDS instead).
Checksum weights that keep the checksum the page already knew (magU, p).
An example in the doc comment the generator writes into registry.gen.ts (text inside its template, so it counts as code).
The U/p frame-field fallback of the old W27 solve path. Shrinks to 0 when Incompressible Flow solves move onto the shared step-list runner and this path is removed.
PANEL_ID_ALIASES: the old panel id panel-incompressible-defaults, so an older plugin's replacePanel still finds the study settings panel.

if_vocab_sdk.reason: Published plugin API, add-only: the kinematic_viscosity unit quantity.
Published plugin typings, add-only: the units Quantity union (mirrors src/plugin-ui/units.ts).
Published plugin API, add-only: the Air library fluid.
Published plugin API, add-only: the is_velocity_inlet BC-record helper.
